# sol.new

> sol.new is the fastest way for everyday people to create tokens, NFTs, wallets, payments, gifts, short links, and DeFi actions on Solana. Wallets are secured by passkeys (Face ID / Touch ID) — no seed phrases, no installs, no signup. Progressive web app in the browser.

Full product map for agents: https://sol.new/llms-full.txt · Features: https://sol.new/features · Directory: https://sol.new/dir · Docs: https://sol.new/docs

## What you can do

### Create
- [Token](https://sol.new/token): Launch an SPL token with a bonding curve in seconds.
- [NFT](https://sol.new/nft): Mint standard or compressed NFTs from an image.
- [Multisig](https://sol.new/multisig): Shared wallets with multiple signers.
- [.sol name](https://sol.new/id): Check and register a Solana name.

### Wallet
- [Wallet](https://sol.new/wallet): Passkey-secured Solana wallet.
- [Get SOL](https://sol.new/get): Fund with card / Apple Pay / Google Pay where available.
- [Send](https://sol.new/wallet/send): Transfer SOL or USDC.
- [Portfolio](https://sol.new/portfolio): Tokens, NFTs, balances.
- [Burn](https://sol.new/burn): Close empty accounts, reclaim rent.

### Payments & links
- [Pay](https://sol.new/pay): Solana Pay link or QR (SOL / USDC).
- [Split](https://sol.new/split): Split a bill; share per-person links.
- [Gift](https://sol.new/gift): Send SOL/USDC via claimable link (`/claim#secret`).
- [Short links](https://sol.new/link): `sol.new/link/<code>` — free random; custom 0.01 SOL.
- [Receipt](https://sol.new/receipt): Shareable transaction receipt.

### Yield
- [Earn](https://sol.new/earn): Protected USDC yield.
- [Loan](https://sol.new/loan): Supply assets or borrow against collateral (mainnet).
- [Stake](https://sol.new/stake): Native SOL staking.
- [Liquid stake](https://sol.new/lst): jitoSOL, mSOL, INF, more.

### Explore & social
- [Scan](https://sol.new/scan) / [Address](https://sol.new/address) / [Track](https://sol.new/track): Lookup wallets and tokens (`sol.new/address/<pubkey>`).
- [Lists](https://sol.new/lists): Watchlists.
- [Stocks](https://sol.new/stocks): Stocks on Solana.
- [Username](https://sol.new/creator/edit): Claim `@username` → https://sol.new/u/<name>
- [Creator](https://sol.new/creator/edit): Profile bio, links, avatar.
- [News](https://sol.new/news) · [Pods](https://sol.new/pods) · [Punt](https://sol.new/punt)

### Play
- [Fair Draw](https://sol.new/draw): Wheel, coin, dice, 1–N with verifiable entropy.

## Key APIs

- `POST /api/gift/create` — unsigned gift funding tx + claim secret (never stored server-side)
- `POST /api/gift` — register gift after funding
- `GET /api/gift?pk=` — gift status
- `GET|POST /api/loan` — lend/borrow markets and txs
- `GET|POST /api/link` — short links
- `GET|POST /api/creator/profile` — profile + username (`?check=name`)
- `GET /api/costs` — live fees
- `GET /llms-full.txt` — extended machine-readable map

## Key facts

- Network: Solana mainnet + devnet (toggle in UI). Loan is mainnet-only.
- Security: WebAuthn passkeys; gift secrets are bearer URL fragments.
- Access: no install; works in modern browsers; PWA.
- Links: https://x.com/soldotnew · https://t.me/soldotnew
- Repo docs: https://github.com/milysecond/sol-new
- /frame — LinkedIn profile frame generator (#OPENTOSOLANA)
